source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 30. Exercises reused from the lesson; du'aas flagged for review.
topic: Guardians of the Earth, and keeping ourselves clean

learn.en: Allah created the Earth, and we are its guardians. Pollution means something in the wrong place.
learn.title: Guardians of the Earth

learn.en: Put rubbish in the bin, recycle paper, bottles and cans, and keep your things in their places.
learn.title: At home and school

learn.en: Water is a gift from Allah: turn off dripping taps and leave shared places clean.
learn.title: Water is a gift

learn.en: Pick up litter even if it wasn't you who dropped it — Allah sees it and will reward you.
learn.title: Allah loves beauty

learn.en: Keep your body, clothes, teeth and hair clean. Brush your teeth after meals, before bed and when you wake up.
learn.title: Keep yourself clean

quiz.en: Who does the Earth belong to?
You see litter that you didn't drop. You…
True or false? Keeping ourselves clean is part of our worship.

think.q: Look around you right now. What is one way you can keep Allah's Earth clean today?
think.a: Tidy your room, pick up litter, or save water!

parents.summary: We are guardians of Allah's Earth: no litter, recycle, save water, and keep ourselves clean.
parents.tip: Do a 5-minute family tidy-up and thank him for his part.
